leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a deque data structure using arrays to maintain window indices
Initialize pointers and variables to track the sliding window boundaries
Manipulate the deque by removing indices that fall outside the current window
Apply comparison logic to maintain decreasing order of values in the deque
Integrate deque operations within a loop to process each element in the array
Render the maximum values for each window position in the output array
Configure the algorithm to handle varying window sizes and input arrays
